items.exampleEn: He tied the rope in a tight knot around the tree.
items.exampleZh: 他把繩子繞著樹打了一個緊緊的結。

items.exampleEn: The glow of the city lights could be seen from the mountain.
items.exampleZh: 從山上可以看見城市燈火的光亮。

items.exampleEn: He smashed the ice into small pieces with a hammer.
items.exampleZh: 他用鎚子把冰塊敲成碎片。

items.exampleEn: She is a devoted teacher who knows every student's name.
items.exampleZh: 她是一位全心投入的老師，知道每個學生的名字。

items.exampleEn: The thief concealed the money under the floor.
items.exampleZh: 那個小偷把錢藏在地板下。

items.exampleEn: The newspaper started a probe into the high food prices.
items.exampleZh: 那家報社針對居高不下的食品價格展開調查。

items.exampleEn: This dictionary has a supplement of new words at the back.
items.exampleZh: 這本字典在書末附有新詞的增補。

items.exampleEn: She took a step backward when the dog barked.
items.exampleZh: 狗一叫，她就往後退了一步。

items.sentenceEn: My little brother can count backward from twenty.
items.sentenceZh: 我弟弟可以從二十倒著數回來。

items.audioEn: The police probe into the missing money will take about six months.
items.audioZh: 警方對那筆失蹤款項的調查大約需要六個月。
items.questionZh: 警方的調查大約要多久？

items.sentenceEn: The candles gave the room a soft, warm glow.
items.sentenceZh: 蠟燭讓房間散發柔和溫暖的光。

items.sentenceEn: My grandfather is devoted to his garden and works there every morning.
items.sentenceZh: 我爺爺全心照顧他的花園，每天早上都在那裡忙。

items.stemEn: She tried to ____ her disappointment, but her face showed it.
items.stemZh: 她試著掩飾失望，但臉上還是看得出來。

items.stemEn: Don't walk ____ near the edge of the pool; you can't see where you're going.
items.stemZh: 不要在泳池邊倒著走，你看不到自己要往哪裡去。

items.passageEn: Every Sunday, our newspaper comes with a science supplement for young readers. This week, it was about a space probe that has been traveling for twelve years. The probe recently sent back photos of a frozen moon, where scientists noticed a strange blue glow under the ice. The writer, a devoted fan of astronomy, explained that the glow might come from tiny living things. My sister cut out the photos and put them on her bedroom wall.
items.passageZh: 每個星期日，我們訂的報紙都會附上一份給年輕讀者的科學增刊。這週的主題是一個已經飛行十二年的太空探測器。探測器最近傳回一顆冰凍衛星的照片，科學家在冰層下發現一道奇怪的藍色光芒。作者是一位熱愛天文學的人，他解釋說那道光可能來自微小的生物。我妹妹把照片剪下來，貼在她臥室的牆上。

questions.questionZh: 科學家在照片中發現了什麼？
作者認為那道光可能來自哪裡？

items.promptZh: 那顆球打破了廚房的窗戶。
referenceEn: The ball smashed the kitchen window.
The kitchen window was smashed by the ball.
rubricZh: 要用 smash（例如 smashed the window）
句型例如主動句、被動句等都可以
時態用表示已發生的寫法（例如 smashed、has smashed 等）

items.instructionZh: 用 knot 造一個句子，說說你綁東西或打結的經驗。
referenceEn: I tied a knot in the plastic bag so nothing would fall out.
I always have trouble untying the knots in my kite string.
rubricZh: 句子要用到 knot（例如 tie a knot、the knots）
時態配合內容（例如 tied、have 等）
